chapter.verse: Khazih’ sawltakte bang leh Pasian’ thuthuk a kemte bangin midangte in kote hong ciamteh uh hen.
Tua tham loin, sumpi keempa in lungsim dik a nei ding hi.
Ahi zongin note akipan midangte in kei thu hong khen leh, a thukhenna thu neu ka sa hi. Ahi hi. Keima pumpi zong ke’n ka kikhen kei hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, mawhsak nadingin ka pumpi tungah bangmah ka mu kei hi. Ahi zongin tua thu hangin kei in thukhenna tawh kipelh mi ka hi kei hi. Kei thu hong khen mi in Topa ahi hi.

Tua ahih ciangin khuamial lakah a kiselte leh lungsim sungah hanciamnate a kilangsak ding, Pasian hong pai dong matengin, a hun hong tun’ ma-in thu na khen kei un. Tua hun ciangin Pasian kiang pan phatna thu a ngah ciat ding uh hi.

Ute naute aw, note in kote hangin, “A kigelhsa thu khen kei un,” a cihna na theih nading uh ahi zongin, kisathei-in khat muangin khat na nial loh nading uh ahi zongin, ka gensa thu note adingin keimah leh Apollos gentehin kong hilh hi.
Kua in note hong kilamdang sak hiam? Na ngah loh, na san’ loh uh khat beek na nei uh hiam? Na ngah, na san’ uh leh, a sang lo, a ngah lo bangin bang hangin kisathei na hi uh hiam?
Tu-in na kicing zo uh hi! Sum na hau zo uh hi! Komau tawh loin na maang uh hi. Note tawh ka man’ theih nadingin note na maang takpi le-uh teh ka ut hi.

Thah dinga kikoih mite bangin, mi khempeuh nungah sawltak kote, Pasian in hong lak zo hi ci-in ka um hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, vantungmite leh leitungmite mai-ah pawikham siim mi-in hong kikoih hi.

Kote in Khazih hangin mihai ka hi uh hi. Note na hih uh leh, Khazih sungah mipil na hi uh hi! Kote in mi thanem ka hi uh hi. Note na hih uh leh, thahatte na hi uh hi! Note in minphatna na ngah uh hi. Kote in zumna ka thuak uh hi!
Tu hun dongin gil kialin, dangtakin, puansilh nei loin, satna leh bawlsiatna thuakin ka om uh hi. Inn zong ka nei kei uh hi.
Ka khut uh tawh gimpi-in na semin ka om uh hi. Hong kikosiat ciangin thupha pia-in ka thuk uh hi. Hong kibawlsiat leh, ka thuak uh hi.
Gensiatna ka thuak uh ciangin ka thuum uh hi. Tu dongin kihhuainate bangin ahi zongin, mun khempeuh ah a kiphiatkhia ninte bangin ka hi uh hi!
Kong zumsak nadingin hih bangin gelh ka hi kei hi. Ka it ka tate bangin hilh nadingin kong gelh hi.
Khazih sungah thuhilh thenkhat na neih uh hangin pa tampi na nei kei uh hi! Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, keimah in Lungdamna Thu hangin Khazih Zeisu’ sungah note’ pa kong suak zo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kei’ gamtat bang na gamtat nadingun kong thuum hi.

Tua hangin Topa’ nasepna pan a diktat, ka it ka ta Timoti note kiangah kong sawl hi. Mun khempeuh ah pawlpi khempeuh thu ka hilh mah bangin, kei in Khazih sungah ka gamtatnate amah in note hong phawksak ding hi.
Kei hong pai lo ding ci-in mi kimkhat in a kihisak uh hi.
Ahi zongin Topa’n a hong awi leh, a manlangin kong pai ding hi. Kong tun’ ciangin a kihisak mite’ kam ciamteh loin, amau vangliatna ka ciamteh ding hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Pasian’ Gam in kampau hangin a kip kei hi; vangliatna hangah a kip hi.
Koici bang deih na hi uh hiam? Ciangduai tawi-in note kiangah hong pai ding ka hi hiam? Ahih kei leh, itna lungsim leh lungnemna lungsim tawh hong pai ding ka hi hiam?
